newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS places Southam on credit watch list.
newsitem.headline: CBRS places Southam on credit watch list.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Friday that it placed Southam Inc on its credit watch list with negative implications.
CBRS said the move was in response to Wednesday's announcement by Hollinger Canadian, a Canadian unit of Hollinger International, to bid for all Southam common shares.
Hollinger is offering C$13.50 in cash and a C$10 Hollinger Canadian non-voting special shares for each Southam share. The total proposed value is C$922.7 million.

"Given the magnitude of the proposed transaction and its credit implications for Southam's debtholders, CBRS has placed its ratings on Southam on its credit watch list with negative implications," CBRS said.
